text.en:
Subsection (b) of section one hundred and eighty-four of Commonwealth Act numbered Four
hundred and sixty-six is repealed.

Subsection (a) of section one hundred and eighty-five of the same Act is amended to read as
"(a) Automobile chassis and bodies, the selling price of which does not exceed two thousand five hundred
pesos each: Provided, That,if the selling price of an automobile exceeds two thousand five hundred pesos, the
excess amount shall also be taxed in accordance with the provisions of section one hundred and eighty-four
hereof. A sale of automobile shall, for the purposes of this section, be considered to be a sale of the chassis
and of the body together with parts and accessories with which the same are usually equipped."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, May 10, 1940.
